what: Measured records of the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next profile. Every row NF never measured is BORROWED from qwen27b by name (UNIFY_PLAN Risiko (c)); an NF record of the same name replaces it.

records.name: P_DRAFT_RESIDENT_BUDGET_MIB
records.provenance: boot fnFL2v71 (21.09.): packed vocab 615.7 (d84f1394fe) + INT4 g32 mtp 1522.7 MiB (a905902f47), 1da8f29f12
records.power_limit_source: not recorded: the boot predates the 24.09. reading and row 27 (no POWER-LIMIT line)

records.name: P_DORMANT_SERVED_GROWTH_MIB
records.provenance: WEG2-DORMANT-SERVED (weg2/dormant_residue.py) over the P logs of the Dauerlauf boots dkrnfh91bar1dauer09262249 (530fb713ce) + 09262231 + 09262218 (2a7f992c14): sleeping P rank per card ordinal, max served residue - fresh residue (PP0 5090 1802-1320, PP1 1284-712, PP2 1080-696 MiB); rc12 D TP0 OOM 22:59:07Z ('Process 477 has 1.69 GiB')
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes a sleeping rank keeps)

records.name: D_FIXED_MIB
records.provenance: #145 fixed post per D rank = 'weights + runtime state' of the runtime's own KV budget posts line - buffer x 48 x 2.417 MiB (weg2/d_awake_rest.py), max over the NF Dauerlauf boots rc12 (530fb713ce, two boots), rc12b (c6868a1e13), rc12c (2e3e38b87c): TP0 20436 - 112 x 116.0 = 7442 in all four; replaces the fnFL2x151/x158 reference 7264/1044/922 the solve priced the form with (rc12c: 'Rest nach KV 1202 -> PASST' beside a card that died).
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes the form holds after load)

records.name: D_AWAKE_REST_MIB
records.provenance: rc12c: what the awake D rank holds BEYOND its booked form, measured against the form and never against the budget (weg2/d_awake_rest.py): demand at the edge (torch OOM line: capacity - free - other processes + refused request) - the form's posts (W+R + mamba + spec + activation + 262144 x cell, same log). TP0: rc12 3129 and 3077, rc12b 3039, rc12c 3186 -- under budgets 29624/29624/29144/28288 the rest stays 3039-3186 (the budget-relative D_OVERSHOOT_MIB it replaces went 428/353/826/1798: no fixpoint). Covers CUDA graphs 498, untagged 2036-2340, unreusable allocator/private-pool cache, unattributed 331-362 at the edge. LOWER bound (the rank died there). 3080 ranks: no edge on NF, not measured (null: the builtin 404 stays there).
records.power_limit_source: not recorded per record; the rig ran 5090 400 W / 3080 230 W (row 27)

records.name: D_ACTIVATION_MIB
records.provenance: rc12e: the D activation post of the #145 solve = the MEASURED maximum of the extend transient on D-TP0 (WEG2-VRAM-PEAK transient_mib = peak_allocated - start_allocated, phase=chunk and the phase=round that holds the draft extend), rounded up to 8 MiB: rc12d (227ae1becd) chunk rows=4059 1101 (max), round 994; rc12c (2e3e38b87c) round 1006; rc12b (c6868a1e13) round 934 -- every window >= 800 MiB carried an allocator retry against the booked 1024 of the fnFL2 reference. The persistent gather ring (16 rows x 2.417 MiB = 38.7 MiB per rank since 227ae1becd) is NOT in this post: it is a fixed post, added to D_FIXED_MIB by the solve. 3080 ranks: no transient edge measured on NF (null: the reference 1024 stays there).
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes one extend adds)

records.name: D_EXTEND_GROWTH_MIB
records.provenance: rc12f: what ONE D extend window adds to torch reserved on D-TP0 = peak_reserved of the window that holds the extend's peak minus reserved at the window's start (WEG2-VRAM-PEAK), max over the extends with >= 512 rows (weg2/extend_trim.extend_growth_mib): rc12e (f078f89a08) 03:39:12 rows=4096 transient 920 -> +2304 (card_free 2371 -> 67), 03:41:23 +2272, 03:33:37 +2026 (retry); rc12d (227ae1becd) 02:37:45 +1974, 02:41:14 +1852 (retry); rc12c/rc12b below. The allocator lays new segments on top of a cache it cannot reuse: growth/transient 2.0-2.5 on the 4096-row extends, so the booked activation (1104) under-prices the extend's card cost. Measured against the window start, never against the trim threshold: a trim empties the cache and the growth that follows is the extend's real segment demand, bounded -- no ratchet. The trim threshold is floor + max(activation, this). 3080 ranks: not measured (null: floor + activation stays).
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes one extend adds)

records.name: D_EXTEND_GROWTH_PER_ROW_MIB
records.provenance: rc12g: reserved growth of ONE D extend per row on D-TP0 = (peak_reserved of the windows from the '#969 EXTENT' line up to the extend's chunk window - reserved at the extend's start, after its trim) / extend rows, max over the extends with >= 2048 rows (weg2/extend_trim.extend_growth_per_row_mib; where the window opened before the trim its peak is the PRE-trim level, then the card_free drop after the trim is the growth). rc12e (f078f89a08) 03:39:07 4096 rows +2304 -> 0.5625 (max), 03:39:12 4072 +2272 -> 0.558, 03:40:51 0.555; rc12f (26af2ccdca) 04:27:50 4029 +2116 -> 0.525 (card_free 207 after), 04:22:03 3073 +1656 -> 0.539, 04:27:45 / 04:21:25 4096 +1992 -> 0.486; rc12d (227ae1becd) <= 0.482; rc12c/rc12b <= 0.225. Rows < 2048 are not a per-row quantity: rc12b 00:18:02, 603 rows, +776 MiB (1.29/row) is the decode/draft rounds inside the same window. A cut chunk has fewer rows and proportionally less growth, so the rate does not move with the cut (no ratchet). The D scheduler caps the extend chunk to floor((card_free_post - 300) / rate). 3080 ranks: not measured (null: no vote).
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes per extend row)

borrow.why: the 27B measurement the NF line has read since its base 76f8debf2c; kept so the NF argv stays byte-identical (P_/D_OVERSHOOT_MIB shape it), printed as BORROWED by the launcher. Replacing a row needs an NF control boot (P_/D_OVERSHOOT first).
